strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ngecek kotak kunci sane mangkin majeng ring daftar pencabutan Google (CRL) lan nyobak makudang-kudang sumber ngantos manggihin kotak kunci sane sah, antuk cadangan otomatis lan ngawitin malih layanan Google. Mamargi ring sabilang kran lan ngamerluang internet (1-3 menit).
strings.mdKbNet: • Kotak kunci saking jaringan: ngunduh kotak kunci saking repositori resmi (GitHub) lan nyimpen ring /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Butuh internet lan ngamerluang galah 1-3 menit. Kaanggén ritatkala smart fetch gagal utawi ritatkala kotak tombol kauwah manual.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • Diagnosis RKP: ngecek modul Penyediaan Kunci Jarak Jauh sane wenten, nureksain versi sertifikat atestasi TEE, lan nyinahang kahanan alat KmInstallKeybox. Nénten nguwah napi-napi — tampilan status piranti biasa.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine cek (wantah kawacen): nyinahang indikator tingkat (Widevine) saking dumpsys, kawentenan file-kunci DRM (IDM), lan sifat sistem sane mapaiketan. Nénten nguwah napi-napi.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP mecikang: ngamargiang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Mecikang pikobet atestasi ritatkala lulus otomatis gagal. Sabilang lari nyetak garis sukses/gagal sane jelas.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Jangkep RKP mecikang: ngamargiang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh jangkep. Menangani kasus sane keras lan ngambil galah sane langkung sue. Pikolih sané tatas medal ring pamuput.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Atur malih GMS: ngicalang data layanan Play Store lan Google (GMS+GSF) lan ngawitin malih piranti otomatis. Wantah anggén atestasi sané bandel — punika nénten naenin ngusud foto utawi berkas Sametoné.
strings.mdCertify: • Sertifikasi muter: ngecek kahanan atestasi sertifikat RKP piranti lan ngatur malih sifat atestasi yening kabuatang. Nénten ngusud data sanganggé.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER perbaikan: mecikang Google kerangka layanan (SOTER) pikobet sane mapaiketan sareng atestasi piranti. Kaanggén ring makudang-kudang piranti sané ngandelang SOTER gumanti Integritas Puter.
strings.mdPifApply: • Terapang PIF: ngamargiang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh gaya. Terapang sidik jari sané kapilih (lokal/lanjutan) lan ngapdet berkas pif.prop/pif.json. Hasil sané tatas medal ring log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF cek: nyinahang kahanan mesin sane sampun kapasang, file sidik jari (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), lan log. Wantah tureksa — nénten nguwah napi-napi.
strings.mdCanary: • Pembaruan Kanari: ngamargiang sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ngambil rilis Mesin Canary sané anyar mangda prasida mastikayang kompatibilitas sareng sertifikat RKP sané wajib (Februari 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Diagnosis mesin: ngecek kahanan TrickyStoreOSS (pid, log), file kotak kunci (aktif vs pengguna), sidik jari piranti sane nyata vs sane ka-spoof, kunci target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP. Wantah tampilan diagnostik.
strings.hintKbSlots: Modul puniki ngatur kalih slot kotak tombol: utama (suci, nenten naenin kaapulang) lan sekunder (cadangan). Tab puniki nyinahang slot napi sané aktif, ngentosin preferensi, utawi ngajegang sekunder ka utama manut pinunas eksplisit — antuk cadangan lan log jangkep.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Diagnosis integritas: ngecek impor kunci TEE, suntikan perpustakaan ring jero toko kunci2, status pencabutan (CRL), cakupan daftar-perlindungan lan kahanan RKP. Wantah kawacén — nénten nguwah napi-napi.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• The protection list is rebuilt from every installed app.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
• Google Play services are restarted.

Nothing is deleted and the primary keybox is never touched.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Slot kotak tombol: nyinahang kahanan slot primer lan sekunder lan ngalih preferensi ring pantaraning ipun. Primer (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) setata kajaga lan nenten naenin kaapulang. Ngajegang sekunder ka primer merluang konfirmasi sane eksplisit.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Promote the secondary slot to primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml becomes the primary slot content.
• The current primary is saved as a backup before replacement.
• Nothing is deleted — the operation is reversible.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Icalang slot sekunder:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml pacang kaicalang.
• Slot utama nenten kasentuh.

Lanturang?
